source_model: Per-outer/seed completed T0_AMP_R1 checkpoint selected only by its own inner loss
label_access_boundary: Runtime consumes GT-free one-click/current candidate inputs and seals own states/decisions; only a separate TRAIN/inner posthoc process adds labels
fit_sequences: Each source outer fold's six fit scenes; inner scene used for checkpoint/policy selection only, outer not for fitting/selection
P0: Own causal short-term motion/lifecycle; immutable anchor and no machine identity-bank writes
P1: Own causal short-term state; write every own accepted current crop into bounded FIFO bank; NEVER GT-positive teacher forcing
mixed: Deterministic alternating complete target episodes under P0/P1 on fit scenes, not a blend of oracle and deployed states
recording_transition: Reset motion/native/pending only; preserve immutable anchor/anonymous token/eligible bank. Previous-recording recency explicitly UNKNOWN, never concatenated-frame time.
candidate_decision: Learned candidate plus explicit NONE argmax; no arbitrary confidence gate silently substituted for the NONE head
safe_commit_embedding: Current accepted crop only; earlier observations validate confirmation but are not silently averaged into the written embedding
T1_supervision: Actual current-state decision/NONE/verified write correctness labels on fit only
T2_supervision: TRAIN-only posthoc next-10 actual frames where target candidate is available: compare projected true-target versus verified hardest-other margin with/without proposed current memory observation. Unknown future/zero competitor excluded, not invented safe labels.
